scope: Proposition 9.11 (Exact extraction) of the manuscript “Finite ordinary minimal model programs on compact Kähler fourfolds” (preprints/Finite-ordinary-minimal-model-programs-on-compact-Kahler-fourfolds-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 056 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b1b9511572d6c717), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 65. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (T, B + M) be a rational gklt pair on a globally strongly Q-factorial compact Kähler space, with projective nef carrier. For any specified finite set E of exceptional prime divisors over T with a(E; T, B + M) ≤ 1, there is a projective modification h: U → T such that: (i) U is compact Kähler and globally strongly Q-factorial; (ii) the h-exceptional prime divisors are exactly E; (iii) the crepant generalized pair on U is gklt with effective boundary.
